protocol.purpose: Engineering and exploratory development, excluded from confirmation.

data.split_rule: Sequential unbiased acceptance of seeded random permutations, reject non-eight-element orbits/history/within-world overlap; no answer-based balancing or selection.
data.independence: Independent data/model/batch/dropout seeds per unit, conditional on the fixed mathematical universe and historical exclusions. Do not force global cross-world disjointness; accidental overlaps do not enter cross-world model comparisons.

historical_exclusions.scope: All original 16m parent inputs plus all currently identified local input-bearing archives; all eight members of every new selected orbit must avoid the fixed history index.

training.precision: FP32 parameters, CUDA BF16 autocast, TF32 disabled; FP32 CPU fallback
training.loss: Answer token plus EOS, shifted causal CE, other targets ignored; same two supervised tokens/example in both encodings.
training.length_schedule: Uniform random permutations of all 21 lengths, repeat then truncate to20k; final length counts differ by at most1.
training.batch_schedule: 64 distinct anchors sampled per update from that length; saved batch_indices.npy shared by all32 models of a unit.
training.endpoint: Fixed final20k update checkpoint; no best-checkpoint or early-stopping selection.
training.execution: Single GPU, serial jobs; no concurrent step0 creation. Resume only when protocol/data/start hashes agree.

protocol.architecture_control: 256-wide four-layer models; Transformer has eight heads. Parameter counts differ and are reported; no capacity-matched claim.
protocol.initialization_control: One actual saved step-0 per architecture, cloned across all tasks and both encodings. Paired encodings share per-task starting RNG. Cross-architecture parameter identity is not claimed.

evaluation.primary_state: final_norm at input end before task token
evaluation.fit_split: validation, orbit disjoint from source train and geometry test
evaluation.answer_strata: Joint [n,left identity answer,right identity/complement/inverse answers]; independently keep strata>=3 and subtract within-stratum means in fit/test. All conditions share masks.
evaluation.undefined_policy: Keep undefined cells; do not reweight incomplete length aggregates.
evaluation.baseline: Numeric0..30 conditional probabilities plus static true-answer onehot/scalar. Static gold has no fabricated initial or training delta.

protocol.inference: One exploratory data-world/source unit per architecture, no confirmation p-values or claims of statistical power.
protocol.completion_rule: Each stage is explicit. Stop after this development report; never launch formal manifest, further seeds, GroupWorld or F17 work.
protocol.new_world_exclusion: Historical input index excludes all old source inputs. Existing development and prior encoding preflight worlds additionally excluded as fixed archives.

historical_index.policy: Reuse SHA-verified historical index, append all prior development input orbits; no historical inputs admitted.

data_audit.independent_world_policy: Independent seeded sampling conditional on the fixed historical exclusion universe. Different worlds may overlap; no cross-world model pairs are primary endpoints.
